messages:
incident-bot: ALERT - inference-prod elevated 5xx and GPU CPU on gpool-9. Top route: /v1/embeddings. Paging @mike_oncall

mike_oncall: oncall, joining. link the perf dash pls.

alex_sre: confirmed. embeddings tail latency spiking; KV cache eviction up 3x. three pods at 95% CPU on hosts eu-west.

julia_support: customers complaining: two startups report timeouts, one mid-market (nova-pay) marked "production" errors.

mike_oncall: immediate plan: reduce embeddings ingress and prioritize chat. propose per-endpoint caps + enterprise whitelist. objections?

sara_prodeng: +1. suggest hard cap embeddings 40r/s global, reserve 40% capacity to chat/completions, rerank -> 10r/s for non-tagged customers.

alex_sre: applying safe throttles and priority reservations now, will ramp-down.

alex_sre: commands:
```bash
# hard cap embeddings to 40r/s with 30s stabilization
redwoodctl quota set --route /v1/embeddings --limit 40 --window 1s --stabilize 30
# reserve 40% for chat completions
redwoodctl route-priority set --route /v1/chat/completions --reserve 40%
# rerank limit for non-enterprise
redwoodctl quota set --route /v1/rerank --limit 10 --filter "!customer:enterprise"
``` 

incident-bot: actions applied by alex_sre. throttles active.

julia_support: notifying affected customers. nova-pay flagged, sending update they may see degraded embedding throughput; escalation open if errors persist.

mike_oncall: monitoring: embeddings qps down ~70%, pod CPU dropped to ~62%, 5xx rate decreasing.

sara_prodeng: ensure enterprise SLAs unaffected: whitelist enterprise accounts under tag customer:tier=enterprise.

alex_sre: added enterprise whitelist rule for tagged customers. command:
```bash
redwoodctl quota set --route /v1/embeddings --filter "customer:tier=enterprise" --limit 1000
``` 

julia_support: nova-pay acknowledged reduced errors after we routed them to enterprise bucket.

mike_oncall: enable temporary circuit-breaker for embeddings: reject when concurrent > 200 to prevent head-of-line blocking.

alex_sre: circuit-breaker enabled (200 conc). incident-bot logged.

ops-bot: scaling suggestion: spin +2 replicas and rebalance embedding shards if sustained > 60% CPU for 10m.

mike_oncall: we'll hold off scaling for now; watching for recurrence. creating postmortem ticket INF-4290 and attaching traces.

sara_prodeng: follow-ups: product to add route-level default caps on customer-created jobs, infra to tighten autoscale and add eviction metrics, support to send customer summary.

alex_sre: will add an automated test to prevent internal scheduled jobs from fanouting > 30r/s per shard.

julia_support: closing loop with customers. currently 3 open tickets, nova-pay moved to whitelist, remaining are low-tier dev accounts.

incident-bot: INCIDENT mitigated • actions and notes saved. Please file postmortem in 24h.

mike_oncall: handing off to alex_sre for monitoring window (30m). escalation: page oncall if 5xx > 3% for 5m.

alex_sre: ack. will monitor and escalate if needed. thanks team.
